resources.string: Lets Jarvis read the Hearthpane screen you are on, point at its controls, control your home through the Control Center, keep reminders, announce to other rooms, manage the household list, set the alarm, read the briefing, read the calendar for any day, read the news headlines, call other Portals in the home and recall or forget what it has learned.

[{\"name\":\"hearthpane.screen_context\",\"description\":\"Describe the Hearthpane screen in front of the user as structured text (Control Center rooms and devices, Music now playing with its play controls and queue, the Settings page and its rows, Calls rooms with their Video call buttons). No pixels or photos. Call it when the user asks what is on their screen or how to do something on it. Results carry target ids for hearthpane.highlight.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"query\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"For how-do-I questions: a few words of the setting the user wants, e.g. dark mode. Adds the matching Settings rows from anywhere, with where they are.\"}}}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.highlight\",\"description\":\"Pulse one control on the Hearthpane screen in front so the user can see it. Use a target id from hearthpane.screen_context, then tell the user what to do with it.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"target\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A target id from hearthpane.screen_context, e.g. settings:immortal.settingsTheme, cc.room.kitchen, music.controls or a room\'s video_call_target.\"},\"hint\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A few words shown beside the control, e.g. Tap the switch.\"}},\"required\":[\"target\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.home_control\",\"description\":\"Control the user\'s home through Hearthpane\'s Control Center: lights, switches, fans, locks, the garage door, blinds, the water valve, thermostats, the alarm and Home Assistant scenes, by room, floor or device name. Call it for any request to change something in the house, e.g. turn off the kitchen lights, dim the living room to 30 percent, lock the front door, set the heating to 70, run Good night. Locking, lights and the like happen at once. Unlocking, the garage, the water valve, the alarm and some scenes are never done by voice: the result has needs_confirmation and Hearthpane shows its own confirm sheet on the Portal\'s screen, so tell the user to tap it there and do not call again or claim it is done. Answer with the result text, briefly; if it asks which room or device, ask the user.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"request\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"The user\'s request in their own words, e.g. turn off the kitchen lights.\"}},\"required\":[\"request\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.reminders\",\"description\":\"Personal and household reminders on the Portal. action add: remember something, e.g. remind me to call mom at 6 (for = me), remind Arjun to pay the bill tomorrow at 9, remind everyone to take the bins out. action list: what reminders someone has (for = me or a name) or the household\'s. action complete: tick one off by its title words or id. me is the person Hearthpane recognises on its Home right now; if the result has needs_person, ask the user who it is for and call again with their name or household. Private reminders are never read out: a list gives only their count. Answer with the result message, briefly.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add, list or complete.\"},\"title\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add: what to remember, short, without the time, e.g. call mom. complete: the words the user used for it.\"},\"for\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"Who it is for: me, a person\'s name, or household. Leave out for the household.\"},\"time\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add: due time in 24-hour form, e.g. 18:00 (at 6 in the evening is 18:00). Leave out for no time.\"},\"day\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add: today, tomorrow or a weekday name such as friday. Use this, not date, for those: the Portal works out the date on its own clock.\"},\"date\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add: due date YYYY-MM-DD, only for dates more than a week away.\"},\"private\":{\"type\":\"BOOLEAN\",\"description\":\"add: false if the user wants others to see it. Defaults to private for adults.\"},\"id\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"complete: a reminder id from list.\"}},\"required\":[\"action\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.announce\",\"description\":\"Announce a short message to the other Portals in this home, like an intercom announcement: each one shows it on screen, chimes and says it in its own voice, e.g. announce dinner\'s ready, tell everyone we\'re leaving in 5 minutes, announce to the kitchen that the movie is starting. Every other room by default, or one named room. In-home network only. Rooms in quiet hours show the card without sound. Send it straight away; no confirmation. If the result has needs_room, ask the user which room. Answer with the result message, briefly.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"message\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"What to announce, short (40 characters at most), in plain words, e.g. Dinner\'s ready.\"},\"room\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"One room to announce to, e.g. Living Area. Leave out for every room.\"}},\"required\":[\"message\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.lists\",\"description\":\"The household list on the Portal, shared with the other Portals and phones. It is both the shopping list and the to-do list, so use it for either. action add: put items on it, e.g. add milk and eggs to the shopping list, add fix the sink to my to-do list. action list: what\'s on it. action done: tick items off as bought or done. action remove: take items off. Answer with the result message, briefly.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"add, list, done or remove.\"},\"items\":{\"type\":\"ARRAY\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"STRING\"},\"description\":\"add, done, remove: the items in the user\'s words, one per entry, e.g. milk, eggs.\"},\"list\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"shopping or to-do, as the user said it. Both are the same household list.\"}},\"required\":[\"action\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.alarms\",\"description\":\"The Portal\'s wake-up alarm, at a clock time (use this, not a countdown timer, for alarms). action set: e.g. wake me up at 7, set an alarm for 6:30 on weekdays. A one-off alarm rings at the next time the clock shows that time. action list: is an alarm set and when. action cancel: turn the alarm off. It rings on this Portal with Dismiss and Snooze, even in quiet hours. The Portal keeps one alarm: if the result has needs_replace, ask the user whether to change it and call again with replace true. Answer with the result message, briefly.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"set, list or cancel.\"},\"time\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"set: the alarm time in 24-hour form, e.g. 07:00 (6:30 in the evening is 18:30).\"},\"repeat\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"set: once, weekdays, weekends, every day, or weekday names such as monday and thursday. Leave out for a one-off.\"},\"label\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"set: a short name, e.g. Gym.\"},\"replace\":{\"type\":\"BOOLEAN\",\"description\":\"set: true only after the user agreed to change the alarm that is already on.\"}},\"required\":[\"action\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.briefing\",\"description\":\"The household\'s morning briefing from the Portal: greeting, time, weather, today\'s calendar, the household list, running timers and the first routine. Call it for what\'s my briefing, brief me, what\'s my day look like, catch me up. Read the briefing text back in your own words, briefly. With show true it opens the Briefing card on the Portal\'s screen instead; if the result has reads_aloud the card speaks it, so just say OK. For news headlines use hearthpane.news; for another day\'s calendar use hearthpane.calendar.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"show\":{\"type\":\"BOOLEAN\",\"description\":\"true when the user asks to see or open the briefing on screen.\"}}}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.calendar\",\"description\":\"The household calendar on the Portal (the one Home and the photo frame show): what\'s on it today, tomorrow, on a weekday, this week or this weekend, e.g. what\'s on my calendar tomorrow, what do we have on Friday, anything on this weekend. The Portal works out the days on its own clock. Read the result message back in your own words, briefly. If the result is not ok, say its message.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"day\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"today, tomorrow, a weekday name such as friday, week or weekend. Leave out for today. Use this, not date, for those.\"},\"date\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A date YYYY-MM-DD, only for a day more than a week away (up to 45 days ahead).\"}}}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.news\",\"description\":\"Top news headlines from the household\'s own news feeds on the Portal (NPR\'s top stories when none are set up), like a flash briefing. Call it for what\'s the news, give me the headlines, my flash briefing, what\'s the latest from the BBC. Say the headlines in your own words, one short sentence each, naming each source once. For one particular story, sports scores or stock prices, search the web instead.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"count\":{\"type\":\"INTEGER\",\"description\":\"How many headlines, 1 to 8. Default 5.\"},\"source\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"One feed the user named, e.g. BBC. Leave out for all of them.\"}}}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.call\",\"description\":\"Start a video call to another Portal in this home, by room, e.g. call the Living Area, video call the kitchen. In-home Portals only, over the home network: never phone numbers, people outside the home or the internet. It dials straight away and the Portal\'s call screen lets the user hang up. Rooms in quiet hours, on a call or offline are not called. If the result has needs_room, ask which room. Answer with the result message, briefly.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"room\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"The room to call, as the user said it, e.g. Living Area.\"},\"video\":{\"type\":\"BOOLEAN\",\"description\":\"false for a voice-only call. Defaults to video.\"}},\"required\":[\"room\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.memory\",\"description\":\"What Jarvis has learned about the person talking: the sports teams, stocks, crypto, news topics and music they care about. Jarvis learns this on its own from conversations, so only call this when the person asks about it. action recall: what do you know about me (show true when they want to see it on screen). action remember: only when they say remember, e.g. remember I follow Arsenal. action forget: e.g. forget that, forget the Warriors, stop tracking AMD. action pause or resume: stop or restart learning. Use what you know naturally and never say you learned something unless asked. If the result is refused, say its message. Answer with the result message, briefly.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"recall, remember, forget, pause or resume.\"},\"about\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"remember, forget: the thing in the user\'s words, e.g. Warriors, AMD, AI news. For forget that, use that.\"},\"kind\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"Only when the user names one: team, ticker, crypto, news_topic or music.\"},\"show\":{\"type\":\"BOOLEAN\",\"description\":\"recall: true to open What Jarvis knows on the Portal.\"}},\"required\":[\"action\"]}}]
